title: Idris Abdul-Aziz
description: After Charlie Kirk was killed, Abdjul-Aziz said he should “rot in hell.”
body:
# Idris Abdul-Aziz

# Teacher and Humanities Department Chair at Millbrook Magnet School

![](/media/uploads/2026/02/aziz-profile.png)

- After Charlie Kirk was killed, Abdjul-Aziz **[said](https://www.newsobserver.com/news/local/education/article312079639.html)** “Black people stating ‘RIP’ for a Bigot White Supremest is crazy talk,” and “This dude lived to talk (expletive) about you and yours. What did he say about Black Women again? Let his ass ‘RIH’ Rot in Hell!!!!”
- Changed his Facebook name to Kofi Vasquez.
- In 2022, **[he posted](https://restoration-news.com/getmedia/8a3239d3-52c1-464c-b423-2aa623b6862d/NC-Wake-Aziz-FB-name.png)** “Power to the People” praising a student walkout at his school.

![](/media/uploads/2026/02/aziz-2.png)

- Posted this (he is a Humanities teacher)

![](/media/uploads/2026/02/aziz-3.png)

- He **[pushes for](https://www.facebook.com/share/p/17t1o5fxYt/)** equity, not equality (equal outcomes not equal opportunity).

![](/media/uploads/2026/02/aziz-4.png)

- Denigrates **[Trump supporters](https://www.facebook.com/share/p/1G1zsgzzGK/)**

![](/media/uploads/2026/02/aziz-5.png)
